      <title>Salesloft: HR Enablement Lead</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><strong>Job Title:</strong> <strong>HR Enablement Lead</strong></p>
<p><strong>Job Location: United States, Remote&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><em>This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.</em></p>
<p><strong>ABOUT THE COMPANY:</strong></p>
<p>Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.</p>
<p>With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.</p>
<p>Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.</p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY:</strong></p>
<p>At Salesloft, as&nbsp;our HR Enablement Lead, you will be a pivotal member of our high-performing People team. Reporting to [manager, confirm], you will own the creation of learning programs and lead high-impact enablement workshops from beginning to end, and you will help build a cohesive, seamless learning journey for our global workforce. You'll have designated programs that you own end to end, from conception through execution, with hands-on support from leadership as the team builds out its capabilities together.</p>
<p>You'll work closely with our People Business Partners, our Associate People Business Partner, and an L&amp;D coordinator who supports the learning platform and content production. Together you will ramp front-line managers faster, equip the People team with the playbooks and training it needs, and make learning part of how the business runs. This role moves beyond administrative operations to focus on strategic partnership and the integration of AI to empower our people.</p>
<p>On a day-to-day basis, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own program lifecycles. </strong>Oversee end-to-end program lifecycles, including planning, development, delivery, and assessment.</li>
<li><strong>Create and lead workshops. </strong>Design and facilitate creative, robust enablement workshops and learning solutions for employees at all levels.</li>
<li><strong>Partner with People Business Partners. </strong>Work directly with People Business Partners to identify and align on specific talent gaps, and build solutions that fit what each business needs.</li>
<li><strong>Ramp front-line managers. </strong>Build and run manager and leadership programs, working with the PBPs, so new and developing managers can coach, handle performance conversations, and lead with confidence.</li>
<li><strong>Own onboarding and new-hire enablement. </strong>Create a consistent, practical onboarding experience that gets new employees productive faster.</li>
<li><strong>Enable the People team. </strong>Build playbooks, training and job aids for PBPs and Shared Services on topics such as calibration, employee relations and change management.</li>
<li><strong>Shape the learning architecture. </strong>Help architect a system of learning that is cohesive and provides a seamless journey for employees at all levels.</li>
<li><strong>Innovate with AI. </strong>Experiment with and implement AI-powered tools to automate workflows, personalize curriculum creation, and continuously invest in AI for workforce enablement.</li>
<li><strong>Drive business execution. </strong>Develop tailored strategies to address performance gaps, with clear objectives, development plans, and accountability measures, and make sure all programming aligns with near-term and long-term goals.</li>
<li><strong>Run the learning platform. </strong>Own the LMS and content library, working with the L&amp;D coordinator on administration, scheduling and production.</li>
<li><strong>Analyze and interpret. </strong>Use data to identify trends, monitor program completions and impact, and provide actionable insights that inform future learning strategy.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:</strong></p>
<p>We are seeking a strategic, results-driven partner who moves beyond operations to become a true consultant to the business. You are someone who understands how individual success drives company-wide goals and can build robust learning solutions that reflect the pragmatic needs of a fast-growing organization. You are comfortable embedding with the business and the People team. You build as well as plan: you ship programs, not just roadmaps, and you are equally at home designing a strategy and running the session. You care about proving that what you build works.</p>
<p><strong>THE SKILL SET:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>5+ years of combined experience </strong>in learning and development, enablement, organizational development, HR, or a related field, ideally in a technology-driven environment.</li>
<li><strong>Workshop facilitation: </strong>Proven ability to lead engaging enablement workshops across a variety of formats (live, in-person, or remote).</li>
<li><strong>Manager and onboarding programs: </strong>Experience designing and delivering manager development and onboarding programs.</li>
<li><strong>Instructional innovation: </strong>Proven ability to experiment with emerging learning technologies, creative modalities, and unconventional approaches that push beyond traditional training while applying adult learning principles.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic partnership: </strong>Skilled at building trust and credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.</li>
<li><strong>AI and technical aptitude: </strong>Experience leveraging AI to automate workflows, analyze insights, or create curriculum; aptitude for maintaining learning technology systems.</li>
<li><strong>Systems thinking: </strong>Strong business acumen to understand how learning initiatives impact the broader organization and culture.</li>
<li><strong>Program ownership: </strong>Strong project management skills with a demonstrated ability to work independently to see a program from concept to delivery.</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on execution: </strong>A track record of shipping programs and learning assets on a deadline, from design through delivery.</li>
<li><strong>Communication and influence: </strong>Effective communication skills to present findings and influence diverse audiences across many company levels.</li>
<li><strong>Instructional design: </strong>Strong foundation in instructional design methodologies and frameworks, with experience developing structured curriculum and learning objectives across diverse subject matters.</li>
<li><strong>Measurement: </strong>Experience measuring program impact and reporting results to leaders.</li>
</ul>
<p>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!</p>
<p>Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official&nbsp;<a href="https://salesloft.com/company/careers/">Careers Page</a>.</p>
<p>We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>#LI-REMOTE</strong></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.&nbsp; The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.</p>
<p>The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$85,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$110,000 USD</span></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-hr-enablement-lead">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/salesloft-hr-enablement-lead</a></p>

      <title>Legion: Senior Integration Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Mexico
</p>

<h1><strong>Senior Integration Engineer</strong></h1>
<h2><strong>Remote, Mexico</strong></h2>
<p><strong>JOB OVERVIEW</strong></p>
<p>Are you passionate about building large-scale applications leveraging public cloud services and integration design patterns? As an Integration Engineer, you will work on developing and maintaining Integration &amp; Automation Solutions for Legion WFM customers.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES</strong></p>
<p>Integration Engineers provide leadership, facilitate analysis and design tasks, and support multiple Legion teams in developing an enterprise's solution architecture. Job responsibilities are grouped across four key areas: Technical Integrations, Customer-Centric Consulting, Legion Product Expertise, and a Commitment to One Another.</p>
<p>Please note this role involves participation in on-call rotation.</p>
<h3>Technical Integrations</h3>
<ul>
<li>Design and implement scalable integration architectures connecting Legion with HR, POS, Payroll, and other enterprise systems.</li>
<li>Design, Build, and Test integrations using Workato</li>
<li>Develop secure and efficient REST APIs within Legion's API-driven ecosystem.</li>
<li>Ensure high-performance, reliable integrations using modern cloud platforms.</li>
<li>Engage with architects and engineers for design collaboration and code reviews.</li>
<li>Improve development practices and stay ahead of agile software engineering trends.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Legion Product Expertise</h3>
<ul>
<li>Gain and maintain deep knowledge of Legion's product and integration ecosystem.</li>
<li>Identify, report, and prioritize product bugs and enhancements.</li>
<li>Work with core engineering and production engineering teams to improve backend reliability and troubleshoot production issues</li>
<li>Stay updated on new releases and enhancements to drive product adoption.</li>
<li>Write secure, enterprise-grade integration code using leading platforms and technologies.</li>
<li>Write well-designed, testable, efficient code</li>
<li>Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle</li>
<li>Conduct peer code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Team Collaboration &amp; Mentorship</h3>
<ul>
<li>Share expertise and mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing.</li>
<li>Contribute to best practices for integration and internal technical documentation.</li>
<li>Support process improvements and advocate for scalable, sustainable integrations.</li>
<li>Commit to high-quality work, setting personal and team objectives aligned with organizational goals.</li>
<li>Standard shift working hours: 0900-1800</li>
<li>This role involves participation in on-call rotation.</li>
<li>This role may require work outside of normal business hours.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>7+ years of business/information/solution/technical architecture experience</li>
<li>Graduate of a university with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant STEM field, including Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant degree</li>
<li>Must be able to work as a team player, yet can work independently.</li>
<li>Analytical, results-driven, and have a solution-oriented approach</li>
<li>Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills, including verbal, written presentation, and listening.</li>
<li>3+ years of experience with event-driven Architecture and Microservices</li>
<li>Demonstrated deep technical expertise in Integration technologies and protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, SOAP, REST, JMS, JDBC</li>
<li>Experience using Linux/Unix environments</li>
<li>Demonstrate proficiency with Core Java.</li>
<li>Experience with Relational Databases, SQL and JDBC (one of Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.)</li>
<li>2+ years of experience using AWS technologies such as AWS CDK, Cloud formation, S3, ECS, EKS, and EC2</li>
<li>Demonstrate experience with test-driven development.</li>
<li>Strong experience with Java/RESTful web services</li>
<li>Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)</li>
<li>Demonstrate knowledge and experience with CI/CD processes and tools.</li>
<li>Proven track record of using problem-solving / root-cause analysis</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>The ideal candidate has workforce management integration experience</li>
<li>Preferred experience in the design and implementation of scalable integration solutions with integration platforms such as Workato, SAP BTP Integration Suite, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit, SnapLogic&nbsp;</li>
<li>Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence</li>
<li>Technical consulting experience.</li>
<li>Experience of working with Docker and other isolation technologies.</li>
<li>Experience working with external applications integrations end-to-end such as Workday, SAP, etc.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>COMPENSATION &amp; BENEFITS</strong></p>
<p>At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Benefits include, but are not limited to:&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>Health Benefits</li>
<li>Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays</li>
<li>Parental Leave&nbsp;</li>
<li>Equity&nbsp;</li>
<li>Monthly Wellness Reimbursement</li>
<li>Monthly Lunch on Legion</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>ABOUT LEGION</strong></p>
<p>Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.&nbsp;</p>
<p>If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.</p>
<p><strong>BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.&nbsp; Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.</p>
<p>For more information, visit<a href="https://legion.co"> https://legion.co</a>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY</strong></p>
<p>Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.</p>
<p><strong>DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION</strong></p>
<p>For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co&nbsp;</p>
<p>We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @<a href="http://legion.co">legion.co</a> domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span><em>Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.</em></span></p>
<h2>How We Determine What We Pay</h2>
<p><em>As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.</em></p>
<h1>Job Applicant Privacy Policy</h1>

(“<strong>Legion</strong>”, “<strong>we</strong>”, “<strong>us</strong>” and “<strong>our</strong>”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.</p>
<p>This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the&nbsp;<a href="https://legion.co/privacy-policy/">Legion Privacy Policy</a>&nbsp;applies.</p>

<ol class="ol-bold">
<li>

This information includes:</p>

We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.</p>

      <title>SimpleTiger: Web Developer: WordPress & HubSpot (U.S. Based, Remote Contractor)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Front-End Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0015/9228/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Sarasota, FL
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.simpletiger.com/">https://www.simpletiger.com/</a>
</p>

<p>SimpleTiger is hiring a <strong>part-time contract web developer</strong> to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role.</p>
<p>We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly.</p>
<p>As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch.</p>
<h2><strong>Key responsibilities</strong></h2>
<ul class="editor-list-ul">
<li class="editor-listitem">Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on)</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Qualifications and skills</strong></h2>
<ul class="editor-list-ul">
<li class="editor-listitem">You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Required skills</h2>
<ul class="editor-list-ul">
<li class="editor-listitem">WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Nice-to-have skills</h2>
<ul class="editor-list-ul">
<li class="editor-listitem">Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">PHP development experience.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Experience with Git and version control.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2>
<p>Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences.</p>
<ul class="editor-list-ul">
<li class="editor-listitem">Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early.</li>
<li class="editor-listitem">Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack.</li>
</ul>

      <title>PlanetScale: Software Engineer - PlanetScale Postgres</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<p>PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. The PlanetScale platform delivers a fully managed, multi-cloud Postgres service designed for the most demanding production workloads. We handle the complexity of provisioning, scaling, replication, and failover - so engineering teams can focus on building their products.</p>
<p>Our customers entrust us with their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our Postgres engineering team and help us build a world-class managed Postgres offering.</p>
<h3>What's the job to be done?</h3>
<ul>
<li>You will design and build the control plane that provisions, scales, and heals Postgres clusters with minimal customer-visible downtime.</li>
<li>You will build and maintain high availability, disaster recovery, and data protection solutions that keep customer databases safe through infrastructure failures.</li>
<li>You will tune Postgres to operate at scale for some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the world.</li>
<li>You will build tooling and automation for database operations, backup, restore, and migration workflows - and participate in an on-call rotation.</li>
<li>You will work directly with customers to understand their workloads and translate real-world needs into platform improvements.</li>
</ul>
<h3>These attributes best describe you…</h3>
<ul>
<li>You have strong experience building, operating, or maintaining large-scale Postgres deployments in production.</li>
<li>You have an excellent understanding of low-level operating systems concepts including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, and performance.</li>
<li>You have strong fundamental computer science skills and can reason about distributed, fault-tolerant systems.</li>
<li>You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy mentoring other engineers, and communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly.</li>
<li>You are self-motivated and can work independently with minimal guidance while making sound technical decisions.</li>
</ul>
<h3>What you will need</h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale systems in production.</li>
<li>Strong proficiency in Go, with experience in other languages like Ruby, Python, Zig or Rust.</li>
<li>Experience building and maintaining distributed, fault-tolerant services.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containerized applications.</li>
<li>Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale.</li>
</ul>
<h3>What else will help you be successful</h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience building or operating a database-as-a-service or managed database platform.</li>
<li>Experience with connection pooling and proxy layers for Postgres.</li>
<li>Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure-as-code.</li>
<li>Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the Postgres or database infrastructure space.</li>
<li>Experience working with remote, geographically distributed teams.</li>
<li>Previous experience at a high-growth technology company.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Why PlanetScale</h3>
<p>We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.</p>
<p>At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.</p>
<p>If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!</p>

      <title>StockX: Category Manager - Trading Cards</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, USA
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.</strong></p></div><p><strong>Why you’ll love this role:</strong></p>
<p>StockX is the world’s leading marketplace for current culture, built at the intersection of commerce, community, and credibility. Trading Cards are foundational to StockX — not just as products, but as artifacts of fandom, nostalgia, speculation, and identity.</p>
<p>We are expanding how Trading Cards culture shows up on StockX through creator-driven, community-oriented commerce experiences that blend storytelling, expertise, and transaction. To do this well, we need category leaders who don’t just understand collectibles — they live inside them.</p>
<p>The <strong>Trading Cards Category Manager</strong> is the single-threaded owner of collectibles category growth within a new, high-priority commerce initiative. This person is the in-house expert on trading cards and sports cards, — and is responsible for translating that expertise into supply growth, engagement, and GMV.</p>
<p>You will act as:</p>
<ul>
<li>The internal authority on the first-hand and second-hand trading cards ecosystem</li>
<li>The external face of StockX to collectors, breakers, shops, graders, dealers, and community leaders</li>
<li>The architect of the trading cards go-to-market playbook for this new initiative</li>
</ul>
<p>This role blends deep cultural fluency, strategic ownership, and hands-on execution. Early on, you will own everything related to trading cards within this initiative. As the category scales, you will grow into a leader overseeing a broader trading cards portfolio and team.</p>
<h4><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h4>
<h3><strong>Own the Collectibles Category End-to-End</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Define and execute the growth strategy for trading cards within the platform</li>
<li>Own category-level performance across supply, engagement, and revenue</li>
<li>Establish quarterly goals, leading indicators, and operating rhythms</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Be the Market &amp; Culture Expert</strong></h3>
<p>Maintain deep, current knowledge of trading card culture, including:</p>
<ul>
<li>Key sellers, breakers, dealers, shops, graders, creators, and brands</li>
<li>Sub-segments such as trading cards (sports and TCG), graded sports cards, etc.</li>
<li>Product drops, set releases, grading cycles, convention moments, and cultural spikes</li>
<li>Pricing dynamics, liquidity, population reports, grading premiums, and resale economics</li>
</ul>
<p>Serve as the internal voice of the trading cards community, informing product, marketing, and platform decisions.</p>
<h3><strong>Supply &amp; Creator Acquisition</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Build and own a pipeline of high-impact sellers across trading cards, sports cards, etc.</li>
<li>Personally recruit and onboard flagship sellers, breakers, comic shops, etc. who set the tone for the platform</li>
<li>Develop seller strategies that balance credibility, storytelling, and commerce</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Commerce Strategy &amp; Category Moments</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Identify and orchestrate trading card-specific moments, campaigns, and formats that drive engagement and conversion (e.g., major set releases, championship spikes, grading returns, convention cycles)</li>
<li>Partner with Category Marketing to design culturally authentic activations</li>
<li>Experiment with new approaches (live breaks, expert drops, themed auctions, etc.) and iterate quickly based on performance and feedback</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Work closely with Account and Partnerships Managers to scale seller acquisition and support</li>
<li>Collaborate with Product and Engineering to shape features and tools that matter to collectors (e.g., condition transparency, grading integrations, pricing insights, population data visibility)</li>
<li>Provide clear, actionable insights from the market to influence roadmap prioritization</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Build the Playbook</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Document learnings, frameworks, and best practices that can be reused across future categories</li>
<li>Help define what “great” looks like for category ownership at StockX</li>
<li>Support hiring and onboarding as the trading card category team grows</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>About You:</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Deeply embedded in trading card culture — you know the people, platforms, trends, grading standards, and economics, and you’re already plugged into the ecosystem</li>
<li>5+ years of experience in category management, partnerships, marketplace growth, brand, dealer, or operator roles within trading cards, sports cards, comics, toys, coins, or adjacent enthusiast ecosystems</li>
<li>Comfortable owning outcomes, not just strategy — you execute, iterate, and adapt</li>
<li>Strong relationship builder with credibility among collectors, breakers, shop owners, graders, dealers, and community members</li>
<li>Data-literate and commercially minded — you understand pricing spreads, grading premiums, liquidity, margin structures, and incentives</li>
<li>Entrepreneurial, scrappy, and energized by building something from the ground up</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Existing network of card breakers, LCS owners, comic shops, grading submitters, toy dealers, or coin specialists</li>
<li>Experience buying, selling, grading, or operating within collectibles marketplaces</li>
<li>Familiarity with grading ecosystems (e.g., card and comic grading workflows, condition standards, population reports)</li>
<li>Experience with content-driven commerce, live selling, or enthusiast communities</li>
<li>Experience working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams</li>
<li>Experience running your own collectibles business, shop, or online storefront</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Why This Role Matters:</strong></h4>
<p>Trading Cards will define the early perception and success of this new commerce initiative at StockX. This role sets:</p>
<ul>
<li>The cultural and credibility bar for the platform</li>
<li>The go-to-market blueprint for future enthusiast categories</li>
<li>StockX’s reputation within trading cards</li>
</ul>
<p>You will have outsized influence on how StockX expands its leadership from marketplace into deeper cultural engagement within the global trading card ecosystem.</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - MX
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><span>Who We Are</span></h2>
<p><span>Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.</span></p></div><h2><span>The Opportunity&nbsp;</span></h2>
<div><span>As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects).</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.</strong></span></div>
<h2><span><span>What You'll Do</span></span></h2>
<p><strong><span>Your day-to-day</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><span>You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving.</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span><span>Who You Are</span></span></h2>
<p><strong><span>The right fit looks like this</span></strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><span>You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions.</span></p>
<p><span>You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions.</span></p>
<h2><span><span>What You Bring</span></span></h2>
<p><strong><span>Skills &amp; experience</span></strong></p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd"><strong><span>Required</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><span>8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems.</span></li>
<li><span>Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><span><strong><span>Nice to Have</span></strong></span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.</li>
<li>Databricks experience or certification.</li>
<li>Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services.</li>
<li>Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks.</li>
<li>Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives.</li>
<li>Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity.</li>
</ul>
<h2><span>Our AI Mindset</span></h2>
<h3><span>We build with AI. We lead with judgment.</span></h3>
<p><span><strong>AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.</strong></span></p>
<p><span>We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be <span><strong>open to experimenting</strong></span>, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.</span></p>
<p><span>In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when <span><strong>human judgment and AI capability work together.</strong></span></span></p>

      <title>Bybit: Animator Intern</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Front-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Abu Dhabi, UAE; APAC - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Us</strong></p>
<div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-XCikdRR2xoZIjdxtCKcuOflrs8d">Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-IF06dI0MPoBwYfxbZ4zui13HsoC">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-X5EbdOwvMoYuOmxQBbuueUEDsDd">Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-LtVud2dO7oglqJxxZoOucqjJsPc">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-RMHkdm4bPo66l3xMVO8ui1o8sle">Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.</div>
</div></div><div>
<div>
<div>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-Po3gdQa3WogkFAxL1Meu0avCsHg">Responsibilities</h2>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-PCdXdyBrLo2AvYxnzRMu60IdsXh">
<div>Create and edit high-quality video and motion content from brief to final delivery.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Nn1ydNcpfoqKrEx7ez7utETOswf">
<div>Animate typography, graphics, product visuals, UI elements, and campaign assets.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-JzTtd0qRJo9HSNx73nsu6Spqs8b">
<div>Edit videos with strong attention to <strong>pacing, transitions, music, sound design, and storytelling</strong>.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-QWKYdjnCToq1uKxHKimuExegsFg">
<div>Work confidently across <strong>After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Figma</strong>.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-BfbbdBXEto8qSNxlbnXu3b1Sshf">
<div>Use AI creative tools for ideation, storyboarding, asset generation, video generation, and creative experimentation.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-OvIQdKH2HoWKS6xy25Suds4Dshe">
<div>Collaborate with designers, creative leads, and other team members to bring ideas to life.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Mr6mdOAEXohRwXxCVdGuLn3KsYc">
<div>Respond to feedback efficiently and maintain a consistently high standard of execution.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-Z6g7d5eCHoD3QWxYzoyupdcJsNf">What We’re Looking For</h2>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-IJ1adFMXgo9zAOxsRI6uj5Ljs3T">
<div>Strong practical skills in <strong>both animation and video editing</strong>.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GypPdcizkoLLEDxPBsiuhbFhsYc">
<div>Proficiency in <strong>Adobe After Effects and Adobe Premiere Pro</strong>.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-HzLVd6n05oTt6px7PMIu9qKYssc">
<div>Ability to work with and animate designs created in <strong>Figma</strong>.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-KciLdW8KLogfh3xvOL3uFJMbsXd">
<div>Strong visual judgment across typography, composition, timing, movement, and transitions.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-ZNnsdcLtxodvpjxWqgIuXvqms4d">
<div>Good understanding of storytelling and the ability to build a complete video, not only individual scenes.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GJXhdS3HhoZB8sxdMg1uoEo2sTz">
<div>Familiarity with modern <strong>AI creative tools and workflows</strong>.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-KukedxT4ro0YiExmF8bu2bVqs0e">
<div>A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating both editing and animation capabilities.</div>
</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-KLSDdHv7WooLoxxuyV0unBiZsje">
<div>Proactive, detail-oriented, adaptable, and comfortable working independently within creative direction.</div>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="heading-2 ace-line old-record-id-F0dLdvL00oyLgZx2EeGuiuJOsnx">Ideal Candidate</h2>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-HW3rdHSnSoqRrKxcQnlut29rsPg">An early-career multidisciplinary creative who is already <strong>technically proficient, visually strong, and ready to contribute immediately</strong>.</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-ZM5ydy0vXoAW1nxO2i3uyKoNskb">You should be confident across <strong>editing, animation, design, storytelling, and AI-assisted creative workflows</strong>, while continuing to develop through collaboration, feedback, and creative direction from the team.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why Join Us</strong><br>At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.&nbsp;<br>Our benefits include:<br>- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.<br>- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.<br>- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.<br>- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.<br>- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-animator-intern">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bybit-animator-intern</a></p>
</description>

Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow.

You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.

","id":"2a55d6c9-c564-443a-be3e-a3851db5a93b","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with companies of fewer than 1,000 employees. While significant inbound demand supports the pipeline, top performers will exceed targets by treating this as a “Hunter” role in addition to converting inbound demand.

• Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demos, proposals, negotiations, and close.

• Manage a high-velocity pipeline across multiple opportunities, keeping deals moving with clear next steps and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data in the CRM.

• Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

• Run efficient, repeatable sales processes and contribute to playbooks that help scale our commercial sales motion.

• Partner with Marketing on inbound and outbound pipeline generation, responding quickly to leads and identifying new opportunities.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges, including how AI is reshaping software development.

• Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

• Present case studies and customer success stories that demonstrate the impact and business value of our products.

• Partner with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations and ensure a smooth handoff to Customer Success to support onboarding, retention, and expansion.

• Share customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

"},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

• You have 4+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including 2+ years in a revenue-closing role, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services.

• You have a proven track record of achieving and exceeding targets in a fast-paced, high-volume B2B environment, ideally selling to small and medium-sized businesses (SMB) or mid-market companies.

• You are skilled at managing fast sales cycles efficiently while maintaining a thoughtful and effective discovery process.

• You bring strong judgment when working with incomplete information, allowing you to prioritize high-potential opportunities and confidently move away from poorly qualified deals.

• You have experience selling to technical stakeholders, including CTOs, engineering leaders, developers, or DevOps teams.

• You are familiar with software development, Product Management, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems.

• You can clearly communicate technical benefits and business value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.

• You are highly organized and disciplined in pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM hygiene.

• You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

"},{"text":"Where You'll Be","content":"

This role is based in New York City

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

    We’re looking for a leader to manage Spotify’s Music Policy team, driving our strategy and execution for many of the most important issues facing the music industry for the next decade. As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world.

    The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions. 

    The scope of policies include how Spotify’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. In communicating these policies publicly, our focus is to educate artists and the music industry at scale, so everyone has equal access to information and resources.

    In this role, you’ll work with a cross-functional team from Licensing, Marketing, Public Affairs, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Music Partnerships, Music Economics, and more in leading policy initiatives for the Spotify for Artists team — from the strategy, development, and implementation of new policies, to public messaging and education, to industry advocacy and engagement.

    ","id":"436046d9-6ac2-4d0f-92ee-a36d957cb566","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Lead a high-performing team focused on building a better future for artists, songwriters, and the music industry on Spotify.
  • Set and execute against a policy agenda for the team based on the biggest needs for artists, songwriters, music partners, listeners, and Spotify.
  • Own strategy and execution around Spotify’s music policy portfolio, including Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, Music Spam Filter, Preferred Provider Program, and more.
  • Develop and implement new policies that equitably impact the music ecosystem on topics like royalty administration, artificial streaming, new music technologies, music platform rules, and more.
  • Partner closely with technical and operational teams on content policy — including platform integrity issues, metadata strategy, and music supply chain dynamics.
  • Work hand-in-hand with product and engineering to implement technical solutions for our policy agenda.
  • Craft clear, informative messaging about existing and new policies — and launch scaled educational initiatives to make sure artists, songwriters, distributors, and rights holders have accurate information about our platform.
  • Collaborate with Music Partnerships and Licensing to understand the needs of all the stakeholders on our music platform, to advocate for and explain new policies, and to listen to and incorporate feedback.
  • Partner with Data Science and Music Economics to deeply understand platform trends and the potential impact of various policy decisions.

    These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide.

    This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data.   • Own quarterly and annual revenue targets for your client portfolio, managing your sales pipeline and identifying opportunities for sustainable growth.

  • Collaborate with agency teams across media buying, strategy, planning, programmatic and branded content to develop effective advertising campaigns.
  • Translate client challenges and business objectives into tailored advertising solutions that deliver measurable results.
  • Develop compelling proposals and respond to client briefs, demonstrating how Spotify's audio, video, display and integrated advertising solutions can support their goals.
  • Partner with internal Sales, Marketing and Product teams to deliver a consistent, high-quality client experience, from initial conversations through to campaign delivery.

","description":"

    Spotify is building the next generation of advertising, connecting brands with audiences through audio, video, and experiences that are deeply embedded in people's lives. As our advertising business evolves, demonstrating the impact of advertising on Spotify, and helping advertisers achieve better outcomes, will be critical to our long-term success.

    We are seeking a Head of Measurement & Advertising Effectiveness to define how Spotify proves the value of its advertising, advances measurement science, and makes advertiser effectiveness a lasting competitive advantage.

    Reporting directly to the SVP of Advertising, you will be a member of the global Advertising leadership team, operating within a business with end-to-end P&L accountability. You will play an influential role in shaping our strategy, guiding investment priorities, and strengthening the value we deliver to advertisers.

    This is an opportunity to build and lead a differentiated measurement and effectiveness organization at a time when the industry is being reshaped by AI, evolving privacy expectations, and increasing demand for measurable business outcomes. We are looking for a leader who combines scientific rigor, strategic vision, commercial judgment, and exceptional people leadership—and who can represent Spotify as a credible and influential voice in the industry.

    ","id":"01b41b49-7d43-4933-9ba7-06ebe0a2a749","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Build and transform the function. Set Spotify’s global measurement and effectiveness vision across brand, performance, and full-funnel advertising, and fundamentally build and elevate our capabilities to get there.
  • Advance measurement science. Lead our approach to incrementality, causal inference, experimentation, attribution, marketing mix modeling, and brand lift, and set rigorous standards for how we measure advertiser outcomes.
  • Define what we need to prove. Set the scientific requirements for measuring advertising impact on Spotify, and influence investment priorities with Product, Engineering, and Data Science, who own building the solutions.
  • Turn evidence into advertiser growth. Build marketing science and consulting capabilities that help advertisers understand and improve their results on Spotify, and partner with commercial leaders to turn that evidence into deeper relationships and smarter investment decisions.
  • Tailor measurement by industry. Develop approaches that reflect the distinct goals and challenges of advertisers in key verticals.
  • Build research and partnerships. Set an ambitious research agenda, develop relationships with leading measurement and technology partners, and advance independent validation and new approaches.
  • Lead what’s next. Anticipate how AI, new methods, and ecosystem shifts will change measurement, and position Spotify to lead rather than follow.
  • Shape industry thinking. Go beyond representing Spotify to help shape how the industry approaches effectiveness and measurement standards, through direct engagement with CMOs and agency leaders, seats on industry boards, major conference stages, and thought leadership.
  • Build an exceptional organization. Design, scale, and lead a high-performing global team spanning measurement strategy, marketing science, advertiser consulting, research, and partnerships.
  • Shape Advertising leadership decisions. Bring scientific expertise, advertiser insight, and an evidence-based perspective to the leadership team’s strategic choices and long-term priorities.

  • You’re an accomplished senior leader in advertising measurement, marketing science, or advertiser effectiveness, ideally at a leading ad platform, technology company, or measurement organization.

  • You have deep expertise in incrementality, causal inference, experimentation, attribution, and marketing effectiveness, and the judgment to weigh each method’s strengths, limits, and practical uses.
  • You understand how advertisers make investment decisions and how measurement drives media allocation, confidence, and growth.
  • You pair scientific rigor with commercial thinking, turning complex evidence into clear priorities, compelling narratives, and actionable recommendations.
  • You understand the product, data, technology, and privacy factors shaping modern measurement, and you’ve successfully influenced cross-functional investments.
  • You’re excited by the measurement challenges of audio, video, and podcasts: formats where traditional click-based attribution falls short.
  • You have a forward-looking view of how AI and evolving industry standards will reshape advertising effectiveness.
  • You’ve built and led multidisciplinary organizations, attracting exceptional talent and developing strong senior leaders.
  • You’re a compelling communicator with the executive presence to engage C-suite advertisers, agencies, and industry bodies, and to make sophisticated measurement concepts clear and relevant to business leaders.
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments, challenge conventional thinking, and balance long-term ambition with near-term delivery.

    At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business.

    Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention.

    We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions.

    Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

    The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

    At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business.
    The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do.


    We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

  • You will proactively identify music trends, emerging talent and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, providing deep cultural and musical insights with the local FR team to execute pivotal initiatives, multi-market campaigns and other key internal partners & teams including editorial, consumer marketing, communications, strategy & operations…

  • Ensure Spotify has the best possible content offering in France and use this to further Spotify's appeal to existing and new users

    We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:

    • Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
    • Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
    • Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
    • Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

    Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

    ","id":"0eebb462-b5a2-4e3a-b830-d8ef7505b014","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
    Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:
     
    Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.
     
    Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.
     
    Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.
     
    You will also:
  • Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.
  • Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.
  • Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.
  • Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.
    • "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"
  • You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Previous industry experience is helpful.
  • You have experience in one or more of the following fields: generative modeling, machine learning, music information retrieval, speech processing, audio processing, signal processing, probabilistic modeling, computer vision, or related areas.
  • You have deep expertise in at least one of the focus areas above—whether that's vocal/speech synthesis, post-training alignment techniques (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DPO), or audio-to-audio generation and text-guided music editing.
  • You have publications at leading conferences such as ICASSP, ISMIR, INTERSPEECH, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, or related venues.
  • You have strong coding skills in Python, PyTorch, and NumPy.
  • You are a creative problem solver who is passionate about building outstanding products that add real value to millions of people.
  • You are enthusiastic about turning research ideas into products operating at scale.
  • You can explain complex topics in simple terms, and you enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

    We’re looking for a Senior C++/iOS Engineer to join the Baldur squad within User Platform (UP). Baldur owns Spotify’s Session Management and Delegated Authorization domains—the systems that enable applications to securely obtain, use, and manage access tokens for hundreds of millions of users. In this role, you’ll help shape the technology that powers secure access across every Spotify client and third-party integration. 

    Your work will support engineers across Spotify building mobile and desktop experiences, platform teams, and third-party developers integrating with Spotify’s authorization platform. You’ll collaborate across disciplines to build secure, reliable, and scalable authentication experiences that have a direct impact on millions of people every day.

  • Design, build, and evolve critical infrastructure powering Spotify applications and partner integrations using shared C++ libraries and native Swift on iOS.
  • Develop secure, reliable, and performant delegated authorization flows, including token issuance, refresh, revocation, and session lifecycle management across multiple platforms.
  • Partner with client and backend engineers to integrate with core authorization services, token issuance, client registration, and token revocation.
  • Improve how credentials and access tokens are securely stored and managed on-device while balancing security, reliability, and application performance.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Spotify’s authorization frameworks, Spotify-specific implementations, enabling new platforms and product experiences.
  • Drive technical improvements, share knowledge with teammates, and help shape the long-term technical direction of delegated authorization and session management.
